core_obligations: Use the nonzero kernel of the differential map to choose a cutting parameter through the point.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose the parameter from the nonzero kernel condition.

difficulty_reason: For a morphism smooth at a point where the natural map from the differentials of the fibre to the differentials of the residue field extension has nonzero kernel, the lemma produces an affine neighbourhood and an effective Cartier divisor through the point which is smooth over the base. The proof uses the nonzero kernel to select a parameter whose differential dies along the fibre, cuts by it, and verifies smoothness of the resulting divisor via the differential criterion. Selecting the parameter from the kernel condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10680-10698.
